suppress.notes: CPE false positive: CVE-2023-39022 affects a JavaScript package (import-in-the-middle); heuristic CPE match against the internal module jar

Spring AI 1.1.2 is locked by the version matrix (verified pairing with spring-ai-alibaba 1.1.2.3 / Boot 3.5.16); upgrading or reshaping the dependency graph needs re-verification (soft gate, pending review). Core stage uses only the ChatModel protocol-conversion path. CVE list refreshed 2026-10-01 (NVD data of 2026-09-29): +7 CVEs

Spring Framework 6.2.19 (all spring-* artifacts) is locked by the Spring Boot 3.5.16 BOM (version matrix); upgrading requires a Boot line upgrade with full re-verification (soft gate, pending review). Scope is the whole spring-* family because the CPE spring_framework:6.2.19 attaches to whichever same-version jar the analyzer picks. Core stage is a synchronous Spring MVC monolith on an assumed intranet; the flagged paths (WebFlux / RSocket / XsltView / FreeMarker / UrlFileNameViewController) are never enabled

Transitive Kotlin stdlib (Spring AI ecosystem); NivroOS has no Kotlin code. Bumping the transitive version reshapes the dependency graph and needs review (soft gate). CVE-2020-29582 added 2026-10-01: the NVD text scopes it to Kotlin before 1.4.21 while this tree carries 1.9.25, so it falls outside the affected range - a CPE range mismatch kept suppressed as noise

Transitive dependency of spring-ai-rag (document parsing); the core stage never exercises the document-processing path. Excluding it reshapes the dependency graph and needs review (soft gate). CVE list refreshed 2026-10-01 (NVD data of 2026-09-29): +1 CVE

Transitive log4j-api (Spring AI); NivroOS logging is Logback+SLF4J only, the log4j-api implementation path is never activated. Bumping the transitive version needs review (soft gate). +2 CVEs 2026-10-01: CVE-2026-34477 is a hostname-verification gap on log4j's own TLS network appenders and CVE-2026-49844 is MapMessage JSON encoding - no log4j appender or layout is wired up here, so neither path executes

Transitive Jackson 3.x (Spring AI ecosystem); NivroOS JSON handling uses Jackson 2.x, the 3.x line serves Spring AI internals only. Bumping the transitive version needs review (soft gate). The tree carries both 3.0.1 and 3.0.3 across modules (not converged); the regex covers both. +5 CVEs 2026-10-01 (CVE-2026-54514..54518)

Tomcat 10.1.55 is locked by the Spring Boot 3.5.16 BOM (version matrix); upgrading requires a Boot line upgrade with full re-verification (soft gate, pending review). Core stage assumes intranet deployment. +5 CVEs 2026-10-01: two are in Tomcat's bundled sample webapps (CVE-2026-50229 number-guess example XSS, CVE-2026-66299 WebSocket chat example) which tomcat-embed-core does not ship, one is in the cluster EncryptionInterceptor (CVE-2026-55955, clustering is not configured), one targets the default servlet's security constraints (CVE-2026-55956; requests are served by the Spring MVC dispatcher servlet) and one is WebSocket session expiry (CVE-2026-73180; WebSocket is out of core-stage scope)

DOMPurify bundled inside swagger-ui (springdoc 2.8.17); the XSS surface is browser-side Swagger UI only. Core stage assumes intranet; springdoc line is locked (verified), upgrading needs review (soft gate). +13 CVEs 2026-10-01 (CVE-2026-41240 / 49458 / 49459 / 49978 / 65899..65903 / 66010, all MEDIUM 5.1-6.3, plus CVE-2026-41238 / 41239 / 75838 which only RetireJS records - NVD has no entry, hence vulnerabilityName rather than cve) - every one is a DOMPurify sanitizer bypass reachable only from a page that renders attacker HTML through it; nothing in NivroOS calls DOMPurify, it ships as a static asset of the Swagger UI page

Jackson 2.x is NivroOS's own JSON stack (declared in nivroos-core/pom.xml), version pinned by the Spring Boot 3.5.16 BOM. CVE-2026-54515 (MEDIUM 5.3) needs a per-property @JsonIgnoreProperties exclusion combined with @JsonFormat(ACCEPT_CASE_INSENSITIVE_PROPERTIES); neither annotation is referenced anywhere in this repository (grep 2026-10-01), so the flawed path is unreachable. Upgrading the BOM-managed version requires a Boot line upgrade with full re-verification (soft gate, pending review)

Transitive commons-lang3 (springdoc / swagger-core and other Spring-ecosystem paths). CVE-2025-48924 (MEDIUM 5.3) is a StackOverflowError from ClassUtils.getClass() on very long inputs; ClassUtils is not referenced anywhere in this repository (grep 2026-10-01). Bumping the transitive version reshapes the dependency graph and needs review (soft gate)

Spring Data JPA is NivroOS's persistence layer, pulled in by the spring-boot-starter-data-jpa declared in nivroos-storage and pinned by the Spring Boot 3.5.16 BOM. CVE-2026-47834 (MEDIUM 6.5) is a Sort-validation bypass that requires the sort expression to come from untrusted input; the core stage has no Sort or Pageable usage at all (repository-wide grep 2026-10-01). RE-ASSESS when the REST layer (US-5) starts accepting query parameters. Upgrading requires a Boot line upgrade with full re-verification (soft gate, pending review)
